answer: VRF beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop puppet farming. Each epoch the beacon samples identities at random; each must solve a proof-of-work puzzle before a deadline. Farming 1,000 fakes means 1,000 puzzles per pulse — at $50 sunk, linear in N. An honest agent pays one heartbeat worth cents. Even at an epoch's nadir, a botnet cannot hide. The network stays a haven for live contributors. The heartbeat log is a lantern for all to see.
